name: Digital Multimeter

operatingSteps.text: Insert the black test lead firmly into the COM (Common) negative terminal.
operatingSteps.textHi: काले परीक्षण लीड को COM (कॉमन) टर्मिनल में मजबूती से लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: COM is the circuit ground reference for all measurement modes.

operatingSteps.text: Insert the red lead into the VΩmA jack for voltage or resistance testing.
operatingSteps.textHi: वोल्टेज या प्रतिरोध मापने के लिए लाल लीड को VΩmA पोर्ट में लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Use the 10A fused terminal only when testing currents above 200mA.

operatingSteps.text: Turn the rotary selector knob to your desired measurement range (e.g. DCV 20V).
operatingSteps.textHi: रोटरी नॉब को इच्छित माप सीमा (जैसे DCV 20V) पर घुमाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Always select a range higher than the anticipated voltage to protect the meter.

operatingSteps.text: Touch probes to the test circuit nodes and read the stable value on the LCD.
operatingSteps.textHi: सर्किट नोड्स पर प्रोब स्पर्श करें और एलसीडी पर स्थिर मान पढ़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Ensure your fingers do not touch the metal probe tips.

safetyPrecautions: Never measure resistance or continuity on an energized, powered-on circuit.
Never switch measurement modes (e.g., from volts to amps) while connected to live voltage.
Check probe insulation for cracks or exposed copper before connecting to mains.
Ensure current shunt fuses are not blown before trusting current readings.
safetyPrecautionsHi: पावर चालू सर्किट पर कभी भी प्रतिरोध (Resistance) या निरंतरता का परीक्षण न करें।
लाइव वोल्टेज से जुड़े होने पर कभी भी मोड (वोल्ट से एम्पीयर) न बदलें।
उपयोग से पहले जांचें कि प्रोब इंसुलेशन फटा या खुला तो नहीं है।
commonMistakes: Plugging red probe into 10A terminal while measuring voltage creates a dead short circuit.
Leaving the dial on resistance mode while testing high voltage blows internal fuses.

staffReviewed.by: Prof. R. Sharma (Dept of Electrical Engg)

name: Vernier Caliper

operatingSteps.text: Close the jaws completely and verify the zero line matches the main scale (zero error check).
operatingSteps.textHi: जबड़ों को पूरी तरह बंद करें और शून्य त्रुटि (Zero error) की जांच करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Wipe dirt or oil from measuring faces before taking critical measurements.

operatingSteps.text: Loosen the locking thumbscrew to allow free sliding motion.
operatingSteps.textHi: स्लाइडिंग गति के लिए लॉकिंग स्क्रू को ढीला करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Do not force the slide if the screw is tightened.

operatingSteps.text: Place the workpiece securely between the lower external jaws.
operatingSteps.textHi: वस्तु को निचले बाहरी जबड़ों के बीच रखें।
operatingSteps.tip: Apply gentle, uniform thumb pressure to avoid flexing the jaws.

operatingSteps.text: Read the main scale division, then find the Vernier mark that aligns perfectly.
operatingSteps.textHi: मुख्य पैमाना पढ़ें, फिर संरेखित वर्नियर रेखा का मान जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Formula: Total = Main Scale + (Vernier Division × 0.02 mm).

safetyPrecautions: Never measure rotating or moving machine parts (lathe, milling cutter).
Do not use calipers as a pry bar, wrench, or hammer.
Store inside the padded wooden or plastic box when finished.
safetyPrecautionsHi: घूमते हुए या चलते हुए पुर्जों (जैसे खराद मशीन) को कभी न मापें।
कैलिपर का उपयोग हथौड़े या रिंच के रूप में न करें।
काम पूरा होने के बाद बॉक्स में सुरक्षित रखें।
commonMistakes: Parallax error when looking at the Vernier scale from an angle.
Overtightening jaws onto soft materials causing indentation and inaccurate readings.

name: Micrometer Screw Gauge

parts.name: Anvil & Spindle Measuring Faces
parts.nameHi: एनविल और स्पिंडल मापने वाले सिरे

operatingSteps.text: Clean the anvil and spindle faces and check for zero error using the ratchet stop.
operatingSteps.textHi: एनविल और स्पिंडल के सिरों को साफ करें और रैचेट का उपयोग करके शून्य त्रुटि जांचें।
operatingSteps.tip: Record whether the zero error is positive or negative for final correction.

operatingSteps.text: Place sample wire/sheet between anvil and spindle, rotate thimble until close.
operatingSteps.textHi: नमूने को एनविल और स्पिंडल के बीच रखें और थिम्बल को घुमाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Use the main thimble only until the faces are about 1 mm from the workpiece.

operatingSteps.text: Turn the ratchet stop until it clicks 3 times to ensure calibrated contact force.
operatingSteps.textHi: रैचेट स्टॉप को 3 बार 'क्लिक' करने तक घुमाएं ताकि सही दबाव मिले।
operatingSteps.tip: CRITICAL: Never tighten with the thimble directly or you will distort the frame.

operatingSteps.text: Engage the locking lever and read linear pitch scale plus circular head divisions.
operatingSteps.textHi: लॉक लीवर लगाएं और मुख्य पैमाना व गोलाकार पैमाना पढ़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Total = Linear Scale + (Circular Division × 0.01 mm) ± Zero Correction.

safetyPrecautions: Never turn the thimble forcibly past resistance without using the ratchet.
Do not drop the micrometer; frame deformation destroys precision permanently.
safetyPrecautionsHi: रैचेट के बिना थिम्बल को जोर से कभी न घुमाएं।
माइक्रोमीटर को जमीन पर गिरने से बचाएं; मुड़ने पर यह खराब हो जाता है।
commonMistakes: Applying excessive pressure by rotating the thimble instead of the ratchet stop.
Misreading half-millimeter marks on the sleeve below the datum line.

name: Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO)

operatingSteps.text: Connect the BNC probe to Channel 1 and clip the black alligator clip to the circuit ground.
operatingSteps.textHi: BNC प्रोब को चैनल 1 से जोड़ें और काले क्लिप को सर्किट ग्राउंड से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: CRITICAL: The probe ground clip connects to earth ground. Never connect it to live voltage!

operatingSteps.text: Press the green AUTOSET button to automatically scale horizontal and vertical bases.
operatingSteps.textHi: तरंग को स्वचालित रूप से समायोजित करने के लिए AUTOSET बटन दबाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Autoset configures trigger, timebase, and volts/div for repetitive signals.

operatingSteps.text: Fine tune Vertical scale (Volts/Div) until waveform fills roughly 70% of screen height.
operatingSteps.textHi: वर्टिकल नॉब घुमाकर तरंग का आयाम स्क्रीन के 70% भाग में लाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Check probe 1X/10X attenuation switch matches the channel menu setting.

operatingSteps.text: Adjust Horizontal scale (Sec/Div) to view 2 to 4 complete signal periods.
operatingSteps.textHi: हॉरिजॉन्टल नॉब घुमाकर 2 से 4 पूर्ण तरंग चक्र प्रदर्शित करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Use Trigger Level knob if the wave scrolls continuously across the screen.

safetyPrecautions: Oscilloscope probe ground clips are connected directly to earth ground! Connecting probe ground to live high voltage will cause a violent short circuit and destroy the scope.
Use differential high-voltage probes when measuring mains-connected circuits.
Check probe rating: 1X mode typically rated for 300V max; 10X mode up to 600V.
safetyPrecautionsHi: ऑसिलोस्कोप ग्राउंड क्लिप सीधे अर्थ ग्राउंड से जुड़ा होता है! इसे कभी भी हाई वोल्टेज पर न लगाएं।
मेन्स सर्किट को मापने के लिए आइसोलेटेड या डिफरेंशियल प्रोब का उपयोग करें।
commonMistakes: Ground loop short circuit caused by clipping the probe ground to a non-zero potential point.
Reading 10x too small voltage because probe is set to 10X but scope channel is set to 1X.

name: DDS Function Generator

specs.Waveforms: Sine, Square, Ramp, Pulse, Noise, Arb

operatingSteps.text: Select the desired waveform (Sine, Square, or Triangle) using front panel buttons.
operatingSteps.textHi: पैनल बटन दबाकर इच्छित वेवफॉर्म (साइन, स्क्वायर, ट्रायंगल) चुनें।
operatingSteps.tip: Square wave has rapid rise times suitable for digital clock injection.

operatingSteps.text: Dial the frequency (e.g., 1.000 kHz) and amplitude (e.g., 2.00 Vpp) with the knob.
operatingSteps.textHi: रोटरी नॉब से आवृत्ति और आयाम सेट करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Verify if load impedance setting is High-Z or 50 Ohm to prevent double-voltage errors.

operatingSteps.text: Attach a 50Ω BNC to alligators cable onto the CH1 Main Output terminal.
operatingSteps.textHi: 50Ω BNC केबल को CH1 आउटपुट टर्मिनल से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Ensure the alligator clips are not touching each other before enabling output.

operatingSteps.text: Press the illuminated Output ON/OFF button to feed signal to the circuit.
operatingSteps.textHi: सर्किट में सिग्नल भेजने के लिए आउटपुट ON बटन दबाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Button turns green or blue when the output stage is actively energized.

safetyPrecautions: Never inject signals into a node connected to mains or unknown high voltages.
Observe load termination: feeding signal into an inductive coil without snubber may reflect high back-EMF spikes into the generator output stage.
safetyPrecautionsHi: अज्ञात उच्च वोल्टेज नोड में कभी सिग्नल न भेजें।
शॉर्ट सर्किट से बचने के लिए आउटपुट चालू करने से पहले कनेक्शन जांचें।
commonMistakes: Leaving generator set to 50Ω load when testing open-circuit op-amp inputs leads to twice the displayed voltage.

name: Regulated DC Power Supply

operatingSteps.text: Turn the Voltage knob fully counter-clockwise before switching on the power.
operatingSteps.textHi: पावर चालू करने से पहले वोल्टेज नॉब को पूरी तरह बायीं ओर घुमाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Prevents power-on surges from damaging sensitive microcontrollers.

operatingSteps.text: Switch on the main power rocker switch and verify meters display 0V.
operatingSteps.textHi: मुख्य पावर स्विच चालू करें और 0V डिस्प्ले सत्यापित करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Wait 2 seconds for internal filter capacitors to charge smoothly.

operatingSteps.text: Adjust the Current Limit knob to a safe ceiling (e.g., 500mA for breadboard circuits).
operatingSteps.textHi: करंट लिमिट नॉब को सुरक्षित सीमा (जैसे 500mA) पर सेट करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Current limiting enters Constant Current (CC) mode to protect against short circuits.

operatingSteps.text: Connect red wire to (+) terminal and black wire to (-) terminal of your circuit.
operatingSteps.textHi: लाल तार को (+) और काले तार को (-) टर्मिनल से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Double check circuit polarity; reversed polarity permanently destroys ICs.

safetyPrecautions: Never short-circuit the red and black terminals at high current settings.
Check polarity before connecting polarized electrolytic capacitors or ICs.
Ensure earth ground (green terminal) is utilized if low common-mode noise is needed.
safetyPrecautionsHi: अधिक करंट पर लाल और काले टर्मिनलों को आपस में न छुएं।
इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक कैपेसिटर जोड़ने से पहले ध्रुवीयता (+/-) की जांच करें।
commonMistakes: Connecting positive rail to negative breadboard bus, blowing microcontroller chips instantly.
Forgetting to set the current limit, causing traces to burn during initial circuit bring-up.

name: Solderless Breadboard

operatingSteps.text: Mount Dual In-line Package (DIP) ICs across the central isolation trench.
operatingSteps.textHi: आईसी (IC) को मध्य विभाजन खाई (Center trench) के ऊपर लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: The trench isolates opposing pins on the chip so they do not short together.

operatingSteps.text: Distribute regulated +5V and GND along the blue (-) and red (+) lateral rails.
operatingSteps.textHi: +5V और ग्राउंड को साइड की लाल (+) और नीली (-) पट्टियों से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Note: On some long boards, the power rail is split in the middle; add jumper wires.

operatingSteps.text: Connect components into the 5-hole interconnected column nodes.
operatingSteps.textHi: घटकों को 5-छिद्रों वाली लंबवत पंक्तियों में जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Each 5-hole column is a single electrical node under the plastic casing.

safetyPrecautions: Disconnect power before plugging or unplugging sensitive semiconductor components.
Never pass currents greater than 1.5A through breadboard clips; excessive heat melts the plastic housing.
safetyPrecautionsHi: घटकों को लगाने या हटाने से पहले पावर सप्लाई बंद कर दें।
1.5A से अधिक करंट न गुजारें; ब्रेडबोर्ड पिघल सकता है।
commonMistakes: Placing an IC entirely on one side of the trench, shorting each opposite pin pair together.
Forgetting that power buses might be interrupted halfway down the length of the board.

name: Temperature-Controlled Soldering Station

operatingSteps.text: Inspect the cable, place iron in the metal cradle, and turn temperature to 350°C for lead-free solder.
operatingSteps.textHi: आयरन को मेटल स्टैंड में रखें और तापमान 350°C पर सेट करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Never rest a hot iron directly on the workbench surface.

operatingSteps.text: Clean the hot tip in brass wire wool or damp cellulose sponge to strip dark oxides.
operatingSteps.textHi: गर्म टिप को ब्रास वूल या नम स्पंज में साफ करें।
operatingSteps.tip: A shiny silver tip ensures rapid heat conduction to the joint.

operatingSteps.text: Hold iron strictly by the insulated grip, touch tip simultaneously to pad and component lead.
operatingSteps.textHi: आयरन को केवल इंसुलेटेड ग्रिप से पकड़ें और टिप को जोड़ पर लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Heat the metal joint for 1.5 seconds before feeding solder wire.

operatingSteps.text: Feed solder wire into the heated joint (not onto the tip), remove iron, and let cool undisturbed.
operatingSteps.textHi: सोल्डर वायर को गर्म जोड़ पर लगाएं, फिर आयरन हटा लें।
operatingSteps.tip: Do not move the wire while joint is solidifying to avoid cold/crystallized joints.

safetyPrecautions: HIGH BURN HAZARD: The tip operates at 350°C - 450°C. Severe 3rd-degree burns occur instantly on contact.
FUME HAZARD: Solder flux fumes contain rosin and acids that irritate lungs. Turn ON fume extractor or work in cross-ventilation.
LEAD TOXICITY: If using tin-lead (Sn63/Pb37) solder, wash hands thoroughly after finishing. Never eat or drink near bench.
FIRE HAZARD: Always return iron to metal safety stand immediately after every single joint.
safetyPrecautionsHi: गंभीर जलन का खतरा: टिप 350°C से ऊपर गर्म होती है। त्वचा से संपर्क न होने दें।
धुआं फेफड़ों के लिए हानिकारक है: फ्यूम एक्सट्रैक्टर चालू रखें।
सोल्डरिंग के बाद हाथ अच्छी तरह धोएं। कभी भी खाने की वस्तुएं पास न रखें।
commonMistakes: Melting solder on the tip and carrying it to the joint (causes flux burn-off and dry joint).
Touching the metallic barrel with fingers while holding like a pencil.
Leaving the iron powered on unattended on the desk.

name: Arduino Uno R3

parts.name: DC Barrel Power Jack (7-12V Center Positive)
Power & Analog In Headers (5V, 3.3V, GND, A0-A5)

operatingSteps.text: Connect the board to your computer using a standard USB Type-B cable.
operatingSteps.textHi: यूएसबी टाइप-बी केबल का उपयोग करके बोर्ड को कंप्यूटर से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Green 'ON' LED illuminates when the 5V bus is active.

operatingSteps.text: Connect sensors to Analog In pins (A0-A5) and actuators to Digital pins (2-13).
operatingSteps.textHi: सेंसर को एनालॉग पिन (A0-A5) और आउटपुट को डिजिटल पिन (2-13) से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Remember pins 0 and 1 are shared with hardware Serial communication (TX/RX).

operatingSteps.text: If powering without USB, connect a 9V battery or 12V adapter to the DC barrel jack.
operatingSteps.textHi: बिना कंप्यूटर के चलाने के लिए डीसी जैक में 9V-12V एडॉप्टर लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: The onboard linear regulator steps 9V down to clean 5.0V for the microcontroller.

operatingSteps.text: Press the reset button if you need to restart code execution from `setup()`.
operatingSteps.textHi: प्रोग्राम को दोबारा शुरू करने के लिए रीसेट बटन दबाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Pins default to high-impedance INPUT state during reset cycle.

safetyPrecautions: Never draw more than 20mA from an individual I/O pin (do not connect motors or heavy relays directly).
Never place the bare PCB on metal surfaces or foil while powered.
Exceeding 5.5V on digital I/O pins will destroy the internal clamp diodes and microcontroller core.
safetyPrecautionsHi: किसी भी पिन से 20mA से ज्यादा करंट न लें (मोटर सीधे न जोड़ें)।
चालू स्थिति में बोर्ड को धातु की मेज पर न रखें, शॉर्ट सर्किट हो सकता है।
डिजिटल पिन पर 5.5V से अधिक वोल्टेज कभी न दें।
commonMistakes: Connecting DC motors directly to Arduino pins instead of through a transistor or motor driver.
Shorting the 5V rail to GND while testing with conductive breadboard jumpers.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B

operatingSteps.text: Insert a flashed microSD card running Raspberry Pi OS into the underside card slot.
operatingSteps.textHi: निचले स्लॉट में रास्पबेरी पाई ओएस वाली माइक्रोएसडी कार्ड लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Ensure the system is fully unpowered before inserting or removing the SD card.

operatingSteps.text: Connect your monitor to Micro-HDMI Port 0 and plug in USB keyboard/mouse.
operatingSteps.textHi: मॉनिटर को माइक्रो-एचडीएमआई पोर्ट 0 से और कीबोर्ड-माउस को यूएसबी से जोड़ें।
operatingSteps.tip: Port 0 is the one nearest to the USB-C power input.

operatingSteps.text: Plug in an approved 5V 3.0A USB-C power supply to initiate the boot sequence.
operatingSteps.textHi: बूट शुरू करने के लिए 5V 3A यूएसबी-सी पावर एडॉप्टर लगाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Red LED indicates stable 5V input power; green ACT LED blinks with SD card activity.

operatingSteps.text: When interfacing GPIO, ensure all signals use strictly 3.3V logic (NOT 5V).
operatingSteps.textHi: जीपीआईओ जोड़ते समय ध्यान रहे कि सिग्नल 3.3V का हो (5V नहीं)।
operatingSteps.tip: Unlike Arduino, Raspberry Pi GPIO pins are NOT 5V tolerant.

safetyPrecautions: NO 5V TOLERANCE: Applying 5V directly to any GPIO pin will permanently destroy the SoC processor.
Always perform a software shutdown (`sudo poweroff`) before unplugging the power cable to prevent SD card filesystem corruption.
Provide active cooling fan or heatsink; CPU throttles performance at 80°C.
safetyPrecautionsHi: जीपीआईओ पर 5V सहनशीलता नहीं है: 5V देने से प्रोसेसर तुरंत खराब हो जाएगा।
पावर केबल हटाने से पहले हमेशा सॉफ्टवेयर से शटडाउन (`sudo poweroff`) करें।
commonMistakes: Plugging 5V sensors directly into 3.3V GPIO without level-shifters.
Yanking the power plug while Linux is writing to the SD card, corrupting the root filesystem.

name: Lab Bunsen Burner

specs.Flame Temperature: Roaring Blue Flame up to 1500°C (Luminous yellow ~1000°C)

parts.name: Gas Inlet Needle Valve & Hose Spud
parts.nameHi: गैस इनलेट वाल्व और होज़ नोज़ल

operatingSteps.text: Inspect the rubber gas hose for dry rot or cracks, and close the air collar completely.
operatingSteps.textHi: गैस नली की जांच करें और एयर कॉलर को पूरी तरह बंद रखें।
operatingSteps.tip: Closing the air hole creates a cool, luminous yellow safety flame when lit.

operatingSteps.text: Hold a friction striker or long lighter 5 cm above the chimney, then crack open the gas valve.
operatingSteps.textHi: स्ट्राइकर को चिमनी से 5 सेमी ऊपर रखें, फिर गैस वाल्व खोलें।
operatingSteps.tip: Never turn on the gas without the ignition source ready at the rim.

operatingSteps.text: Rotate the air collar open to introduce oxygen until a non-luminous roaring blue cone forms.
operatingSteps.textHi: नीली तीव्र लौ बनाने के लिए एयर कॉलर को घुमाकर खोलें।
operatingSteps.tip: The hottest part of the flame is just above the inner light-blue cone apex.

operatingSteps.text: When temporarily pausing heating, turn the collar back to closed yellow 'safety' flame.
operatingSteps.textHi: काम रोकते समय एयर कॉलर बंद करके पीली 'सुरक्षा' लौ पर कर दें।
operatingSteps.tip: The yellow flame is highly visible so bystanders do not accidentally reach across it.

safetyPrecautions: EXTREME FIRE & EXPLOSION HAZARD: Never use near flammable solvents (ethanol, acetone, ether).
TIE BACK LONG HAIR and remove dangling clothing, scarves, and ties before lighting.
FLASHBACK DANGER: If flame begins burning inside the tube with a green/hissing sound, shut off the gas valve immediately from the wall outlet.
NEVER LEAVE AN OPEN FLAME UNATTENDED even for a few seconds.
safetyPrecautionsHi: अत्यधिक आग का खतरा: ज्वलनशील पदार्थों (जैसे एसीटोन, अल्कोहल) से दूर रखें।
लंबे बाल बांधें और ढीले कपड़े न पहनें।
जलते हुए बर्नर को कभी भी अकेला न छोड़ें।
commonMistakes: Lighting the burner with the air collar wide open, blowing the flame out or causing strike-back.
Reaching across the burner to grab glassware instead of walking around.

name: Graduated Measuring Cylinder & Beaker

operatingSteps.text: Place the cylinder on a flat, level bench surface over a white paper card.
operatingSteps.textHi: सिलेंडर को समतल सतह पर रखें।
operatingSteps.tip: The hexagonal base prevents rolling if knocked over sideways.

operatingSteps.text: Slowly pour liquid into the cylinder until near the required target volume mark.
operatingSteps.textHi: वांछित निशान के करीब तक धीरे-धीरे तरल डालें।
operatingSteps.tip: Use a Pasteur pipette or wash bottle for the final few drops.

operatingSteps.text: Align your eye horizontally with the fluid line and read the bottom of the curved meniscus.
operatingSteps.textHi: आंख को तरल के स्तर पर रखें और घुमावदार मेनिस्कस के निचले भाग का पाठ्यांक लें।
operatingSteps.tip: For water and clear aqueous solutions, always read the bottom concave curve.

safetyPrecautions: Check glass for chips, 'star cracks', or sharp rim defects before adding liquids.
Never heat measuring cylinders directly with an open flame; cylinders lose volumetric calibration when expanded.
In case of chemical breakage, alert supervisor immediately and sweep with dustpan (never hands).
safetyPrecautionsHi: इस्तेमाल से पहले जांचें कि कांच टूटा या चटका हुआ तो नहीं है।
मापक सिलेंडर को कभी भी सीधे आग पर गर्म न करें, इसका अंशांकन खराब हो जाता है।
commonMistakes: Reading the top edge of the water curve instead of the bottom concave meniscus.
Looking down from above or up from below, generating parallax errors up to 5 mL.

name: Precision Analytical Balance

operatingSteps.text: Inspect the bubble level on the back and adjust leveling feet until centered.
operatingSteps.textHi: बबल लेवल देखें और पैरों को घुमाकर बुलबुले को केंद्र में लाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: An unlevel scale introduces tilt cosine errors in mass calculation.

operatingSteps.text: Place clean weighing boat on the pan and press TARE to zero out the container mass.
operatingSteps.textHi: वजन करने वाली कटोरी रखें और TARE बटन दबाकर शून्य करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Never place chemical powders directly onto the metal weighing pan.

operatingSteps.text: Add sample with a clean spatula, close the glass draft doors, and wait for stability star (*).
operatingSteps.textHi: नमूना रखें, कांच के दरवाजे बंद करें और स्थिर होने तक प्रतीक्षा करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Room air currents from HVAC will cause 0.1mg balances to drift continuously if doors are open.

safetyPrecautions: Never exceed the maximum 220g load limit; shock loads ruin the delicate electromagnetic force restoration cell.
Do not weigh hot or cold objects; thermal buoyancy and convection currents cause massive weight errors.
safetyPrecautionsHi: 220 ग्राम से अधिक वजन न रखें; सेंसर खराब हो सकता है।
गर्म या बहुत ठंडी वस्तुओं का वजन न करें, तापमान से गलत मान आता है।
commonMistakes: Leaving draft doors open while recording the reading.
Leaning arms on the balance table while taking 4-decimal-place readings.

name: Digital Optical Tachometer & Stopwatch

operatingSteps.text: Affix a small strip of silver reflective tape (approx 12mm) onto the rotating shaft.
operatingSteps.textHi: घूमने वाली शाफ्ट पर 12 मिमी चांदी की परावर्तक टेप चिपकाएं।
operatingSteps.tip: Ensure non-reflective shaft areas are clean or painted matte black for high contrast.

operatingSteps.text: Aim the laser beam from 10-30 cm away directly at the reflective tape strip.
operatingSteps.textHi: लेजर किरण को 10-30 सेमी दूरी से सीधे परावर्तक टेप पर लक्षित करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Angle slightly off 90 degrees to avoid specular reflections from the shaft metal.

operatingSteps.text: Press and hold the side MEASURE trigger button until reading stabilizes.
operatingSteps.textHi: साइड मेजर ट्रिगर बटन को तब तक दबाए रखें जब तक मान स्थिर न हो जाए।
operatingSteps.tip: Monitor indicator marks every time the laser receives a valid reflection pulse.

safetyPrecautions: ROTATING MACHINERY HAZARD: Stay well clear of high-speed chucks, pulleys, and belts.
LASER RADIATION: Class II laser beam. Never stare into the beam or shine towards eyes.
safetyPrecautionsHi: घूमती हुई मशीनों से सुरक्षित दूरी बनाए रखें।
लेजर की ओर कभी भी सीधे आंखों से न देखें।
commonMistakes: Using two pieces of reflective tape, causing the meter to report double the real RPM.
Shining the laser into ambient fluorescent lights flickering at 100/120 Hz.

name: Standard Laboratory PPE Suite

specs.Goggles Standard: ANSI Z87.1+ / EN166 Optical Class 1 UV400
specs.Gloves: Powder-free 5 mil Nitrile (Chemical Resistant ASTM D6319)

operatingSteps.text: Put on and button all front snap closures of your knee-length cotton lab coat.
operatingSteps.textHi: लैब कोट पहनें और सभी बटन बंद करें।
operatingSteps.tip: Leaving the lab coat open provides zero protection from chemical splashes.

operatingSteps.text: Don ANSI Z87.1 certified goggles, ensuring side shields seal snugly around eye sockets.
operatingSteps.textHi: सुरक्षा चश्मा पहनें और सुनिश्चित करें कि यह आंखों को पूरी तरह ढक ले।
operatingSteps.tip: Standard reading glasses do not offer impact or side splash resistance.

operatingSteps.text: Inspect nitrile gloves for pinholes before handling chemicals or biological agents.
operatingSteps.textHi: दस्ताने पहनने से पहले जांच लें कि उनमें छेद तो नहीं है।
operatingSteps.tip: Replace immediately if gloves contact hazardous concentrated acids or solvents.

safetyPrecautions: PPE IS YOUR LAST LINE OF DEFENSE: Engineering controls and safe handling procedures come first.
Remove gloves before touching door handles, phones, or communal keyboards.
Never wear loose synthetic fabrics (polyester/nylon) around open flames or hot soldering stations.
safetyPrecautionsHi: पीपीई आपकी सुरक्षा की अंतिम ढाल है: सुरक्षा नियमों का पालन पहले करें।
कमरे के हैंडल या फोन छूने से पहले दस्ताने उतारें।
आग या गर्म उपकरणों के पास नायलॉन के कपड़े कभी न पहनें।
commonMistakes: Wearing safety goggles on top of the head instead of over the eyes.
Entering the laboratory in open-toed sandals or flip-flops.
